settings.nav: Show a Member map link in the forum sidebar
settings.profile: Let members show their location on their profile and user card
settings.jitter: Scatter members a little within their city
settings.jitter_help: Members who chose city level are moved up to about 3 km from the city center, the same way every time, so a busy city doesn't stack everyone on one point.
settings.allow_indexing: Let search engines index the map page
settings.allow_indexing_help: Off by default: the page asks search engines not to index it. Member data is never sent to search engines either way.
settings.meetup_tag_help: Every meetup starts a discussion. With tags on, members need this tag set to plan one.
settings.style_url_help: A MapLibre vector style. Leave empty to use the map tile address below instead. The default, OpenFreeMap, is free and needs no key.
settings.style_dark_url: Map style address in dark mode
settings.style_dark_url_help: Optional. Used when the forum is dark. Leave empty to use the style above.
settings.tiles_url_help: Picture tiles for when the style above is empty or can't load, and for the small map on profiles. Leave empty for OpenStreetMap, which needs no key.
settings.attribution_help: The credit shown with the picture tiles. Most map providers require one. Simple HTML links are allowed.
settings.geocoder_url_help: Leave empty for OpenStreetMap's free Nominatim service. Any service with the same API works, such as your own Nominatim or LocationIQ. Searches run on your server, one a second at most, and every answer is saved for 30 days.
settings.geocoder_key_help: Optional. Only for services that need one. It is never sent to browsers.
settings.geocoder_email: Contact email for the place search
settings.geocoder_email_help: Optional. Nominatim asks busy sites for an address it can write to if something goes wrong.
